mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_MESSAGE m LEFT JOIN TB_DEPT d ON m.DEPT_ID = d.DEPT_ID

SELECT d.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, m.MSG_CODE AS msgCode, m.FORBID_YN AS forbidYn, m.MSG_TITLE AS msgTitle, m.REG_DT AS regDt, m.SEND_POINT AS sendPoint, m.MSG_CONTENT AS msgContent FROM TB_MESSAGE m LEFT JOIN TB_DEPT d ON m.DEPT_ID = d.DEPT_ID ORDER BY m.REG_DT DESC, m.MSG_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
